text:
mia: Quick sync — SiteBricks private rollout status? Need a short owner map for network, certs, and CRs.
arnold: I'm owning VPC plumbing + firewall rules. WIP on ACLs, will post exact egress list by EOD.
sofia: Security owns cert provisioning and KMS/HSM integration. Still waiting on customer CA bundle from AcmeCorp. Pinged them.
ranjit: Runtime team will handle image signing and airgap packaging. I have a blocker: our image-builder CI currently fails for musl base in airgap mode (PR #4123).
lina: I'm coordinating CS + customer cutover tasks. Need canary window and contact for on-prem ops at Acme.
mia: Cool. Concrete asks: (1) arnold — can you confirm required outbound ports and proxy hostnames? (2) sofia — can we accept a customer-supplied CA bundle or do they need our distro? (3) ranjit — estimate for PR #4123 fix / workaround. (4) lina — list of customer ops contacts by tomorrow.
arnold: Ports: 443 outbound to s3.internal.redwood-infra.com and 443 to kube-api.* regions. Also allow 123/udp for NTP. I will paste ACL snippet shortly.
arnold: ACL snippet: ```
# example egress
allow tcp:443 -> s3.internal.redwood-infra.com
allow tcp:443 -> registry.redwood-infra.com
allow udp:123 -> ntp.pool.org
```
sofia: We can accept customer CA bundle if they include full chain in PEM. If they want KMS integration (envelope encryption), we need their KMS endpoint + IAM role mapping. Also need signed attestation for HSM use.
ranjit: PR #4123: root cause is glibc-specific linker flags. Quick workaround: build with legacy builder image (image-builder:v2) — adds ~12m to build time. I'll open a short-lived hotfix branch and push by tomorrow morning.
lina: Customer ops contact: marcus@acme.com, s_jensen@acme.com. They can do a dry run staging on Friday. Asking them to join the canary call.
mia: Thanks. Two more items: code reviews and rollout timeline. Who can review runtime hotfix + infra ACL?
arnold: I'll review the infra ACL PR tonight (PR #4198).
ranjit: I'll request a review from @arnold and @sofia on the hotfix PR.
sofia: I'll review KMS integration doc and the cert acceptance notes.
mia: Rollout timeline proposal: Friday staging dry-run -> Monday canary (10:00 PDT) -> Wednesday full cutover (night window). Any objections?
lina: I think we should add a rollback playbook step to the Friday runbook. I'll draft a 10-step rollback and post.
ranjit: Can we include a quick healthcheck command for ops to run in airgapped env? Something non-cloud dependent.
arnold: Yes, use this local probe: ```
# run on bastion
curl -sS --cacert /etc/ssl/customer-ca.pem https://10.0.2.5:8443/_healthz
```
mia: Perfect. To summarize action items: arnold (ACL + review PR #4198, due tonight), sofia (confirm CA acceptance flow + KMS checklist, due EOD), ranjit (hotfix branch + PR #4201, due tomorrow morning), lina (rollback playbook + confirm customer ops contacts & canary invite, due EOD). marcus@acme.com to confirm staging window.
deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline status: staging cluster image registry reachable: OK; image-builder:v3 builds: failed (see PR #4123).
sofia: Noted — I'll follow up with compliance on attestation doc.
lina: I'll send the canary invite after I get confirmation from Marcus.
mia: Thanks everyone. If anyone hits a hard blocker, ping here and we can escalate to oncall. :thumbsup:
